newsitem.title: USA: New World sees positive Q4 cash flow.
newsitem.headline: New World sees positive Q4 cash flow.

text.p: Coffee bar company New World Coffee Inc said on Thursday the company expected to have positive cash flow in the 1996 fourth quarter.

Management expected to have a total of 40 stores in the New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Connecticut markets by the end of 1996, expanding to 80 stores during 1997, the company said. It said it also expected to enter the Boston and Washington D.C. market then.
New World Coffee has 36 expresso bars in the northeastern United States.
